audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking animatedly outside a door, answered by a male voice from inside a room. There is no background music, only faint indoor room tone. (2) Multiple sharp electrical crackling sounds (SFX) are heard, indicating the use of an electric fly swatter. This is followed by loud laughter from the female and excited exclamations from the male, showing high emotional arousal. (3) The sounds of footsteps and the physical mechanical clicking of the door handle occur as the person inside prepares to exit. The speech rate increases during the search. (4) The door opens, and the voices become clearer and more direct. Final percussive taps and cheering sounds occur as they confirm the fly has been caught, ending with a positive emotional valence.
